evidence.title: Colt Frankfurt Three Hyperscale Data Centre | Frankfurt Data Centre | Colt DCS
evidence.excerpt: Colt says it is currently building the first phase of Frankfurt 3 in Sossenheim and that the completed facility is designed to deliver 32.4 MW of IT power.

metadata.retrieved_at_semantics: The evidence retrieved_at is the shared completion timestamp for the four-body Colt next-tranche audit batch. The exact request-start, response HTTP Date, and Last-Modified header are preserved separately.
metadata.source_date_guardrail: The embedded WebPage publication and modification timestamps are page metadata. The later HTTP Last-Modified header is retained as response metadata and is not recast as a physical construction-observation timestamp.
metadata.status_scope: The page says Colt is currently in the process of building the first phase of Frankfurt 3. This supports one generic facility-build under_construction observation only, not a more specific shell, MEP, commissioning, completion, or operating stage.
metadata.phase_scope_guardrail: The page names a first phase but supplies no phase-specific boundary, power figure, or separate physical identity. No phase child project is created, and the facility-wide 32.4 MW design figure is not assigned to phase one.
metadata.capacity_scope: The page says that on completion Frankfurt 3 will deliver 32.4 MW of IT power. It is imported once as planned full-facility critical-IT capacity, not phase-one capacity, current load, gross facility power, grid draw, generation, or measured energy consumption.
metadata.completion_guardrail: On completion is capacity-design context, not evidence that the facility or any phase is complete, commissioned, energized, or operating. No target date is imported.
metadata.classification_guardrail: Cloud, AI, HPC, and increasing IT workload wording describes intended design and customer-use context. It is not imported as a current workload, tenant, customer, role, or operating-model observation.
metadata.renewable_guardrail: Future renewable-power and sustainability wording elsewhere on Colt materials does not establish current energy supply, generation, annual consumption, or operation and is not imported.
metadata.corporate_address_guardrail: The embedded JSON-LD author address Colt House, 20 Great Eastern Street, London EC2A 3EH is Colt's corporate address, not Frankfurt 3. It is rejected; only the source-explicit Sossenheim, Frankfurt locality is preserved.
metadata.coordinate_guardrail: Coordinates and geometry remain null. Sossenheim, Frankfurt is an authoritative locality, not a geocode, street address, parcel, footprint, building centroid, or unique-site coordinate.
metadata.imagery_guardrail: Satellite imagery and computer vision play no role in identity or lifecycle status.
